# telnyx_dynamic_emergency_endpoint (Data Source)

An endpoint for dynamic emergency calling, which links a callback number and caller name to a dynamic emergency address.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Read-Only

- `callback_number` (String)
- `caller_name` (String)
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the resource was created
- `dynamic_emergency_address_id` (String) An id of a currently active dynamic emergency location.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `sip_from_id` (String)
- `status` (String) Status of dynamic emergency address
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the resource was last updated
